Name: Return to Mineral town portraits in SoS style
Author: tofuuHaus
Description:
The art is from Story of Seasons Friends of Mineral town and A Wonderful Life.
Currently, there are only normal mood and happy portraits for each character.
Still, there is no portrait for Aja and Tate.

How to install
1. Install SMAPI and Portraiture mod
2. Add ‘Portraits’ folder in Portraiture folder if you didn’t have it before
3. Add a new folder for a portrait collection and name it
4. Extract the files to Mods folder which are written into Portraiture folder
5. If this is the first time you use Portraiture, talk to someone in game and press ‘p’ until the portrait change to the one in folder in 3.
